title: SKG in Practice: OOD Generalization Cases Across FourDomains
abstract: arXiv:2610.32314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents the engineering implementation methods of the SKG inference framework and provides complete case studies across four domains. Case 1, 2D Dissipative Mechanical System: OOD MSE is 1.69 to 4.12 times lower than the best neural baseline; the state-dependent metric yields a 10^8-order improvement under controlled conditions. Case 2, Target Detection Sim-to-Real: Real-machine mAP increases from 0.2564 to 0.4964 (+24.00 points, single-run experiment, 32 images, point estimate), and AP75 increases from 0.1736 to 0.5765 (+40.29 points), with no real-machine retraining required. Case 3, Sequence Modeling sine to square: OOD MSE is 0.0296 versus Transformer 0.0641 (mean of 5 seeds, p=0.024). Case 4, Molecular Dynamics MD17: ID@100 ADE is 0.0285 versus ESTAG 0.1467; OOD@100 is 0.0316 versus 0.1411 (single seed). translated_title: SKG实践：跨四个领域的OOD泛化案例研究
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了SKG推理框架的工程实现方法，并提供了跨四个领域的完整案例研究。案例1，二维耗散机械系统：OOD MSE比最佳神经基线低1.69至4.12倍；在受控条件下，状态相关度量带来了10^8量级的改进。案例2，目标检测的模拟到真实迁移：真实机器上的mAP从0.2564提升至0.4964（+24.00个百分点，单次运行实验，32张图像，点估计），AP75从0.1736提升至0.5765（+40.29个百分点），且无需在真实机器上重新训练。案例3，序列建模从正弦到方波：OOD MSE为0.0296，而Transformer为0.0641（5个随机种子的平均值，p=0.024）。案例4，分子动力学MD17：ID@100 ADE为0.0285，而ESTAG为0.1467；OOD@100为0.0316，而ESTAG为0.1411（单种子）。对于每个案例，我们展示了研究目标、所应用的SKG理论、参数设置、基线比较协议、数据……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: SKG推理框架的工程实现在耗散机械系统、目标检测Sim-to-Real、序列建模和分子动力学四个领域的案例研究中，均显著优于神经基线方法，大幅提升了OOD（分布外）泛化性能。
en_tdlr: Engineering implementation of the SKG inference framework is demonstrated through four domain case studies (dissipative mechanical systems, detection Sim-to-Real, sequence modeling, and molecular dynamics), achieving substantial OOD generalization improvements over neural baselines.
